name: thesis-csbapr-symbolic-bus-v2
center: Keep the current line, bus, station, time, demand, speed and timetable context; replace forward/backward headways by the timetable target. Neural policy residual is zero at this projected state, not the complete holding command.
symbolic_reference: Per-line controlled SINDy increments plus sparse station-interval cost regression; two-station constant-action rollout and smooth softmin over admissible holding candidates. It is an approximate fitted feedback, not an optimal controller or an identified full Markov model.
no_symbolic: Replace the fitted reference by Daganzo for headway or zero-extra-holding for passenger, and disable both symbolic losses. This removes the symbolic bundle, not just one loss.
cost: Headway uses the unchanged native CS bus reward. Passenger uses -(2*global_wait_increment+global_in_vehicle_increment) between same-vehicle observations; overlapping rewards are not summed for system evaluation.
selection: Final uninterrupted 100-episode endpoint, both paired seeds and all nine test cases retained. No selection by test outcome.
preservation: All new artifacts live inside csbapr_symbolic_bus_v2. Legacy runners and their frozen runtime are used unchanged for reruns with a new output path. CS-BAPR source is copied from the completed validation-v8 snapshot, not the active working tree. No original checkpoint, result or thesis text is replaced. Identification costs and direct fitted-feedback controls are reported separately.
